rules.title: Xcode DerivedData
rules.why_safe: Build intermediates and indexes. Xcode rebuilds them on the next build.
rules.rebuild_hint: Next build and indexing take longer

rules.title: iOS DeviceSupport
rules.why_safe: Debug symbols copied from devices you connected. Xcode copies them again the next time you debug on that device and OS version.
rules.rebuild_hint: Reconnecting a device takes several minutes

rules.title: Simulator caches
rules.why_safe: Cached data for iOS simulators (dyld and runtime caches). Simulators rebuild it on next launch. Your simulator apps and data are not touched.

rules.title: Homebrew downloads
rules.why_safe: Downloaded bottles and source archives. Homebrew downloads them again if it needs them. Installed packages are not touched.

rules.title: npm cache
rules.why_safe: npm's download cache. Packages are fetched again on the next install. Your projects' node_modules are not touched.
rules.rebuild_hint: Next npm install downloads packages again

rules.title: Yarn cache
rules.why_safe: Yarn's download cache. Packages are fetched again on the next install.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.why_safe: pip's download and wheel cache. Packages are fetched again on the next install. Installed packages and virtual environments are not touched.

rules.title: CocoaPods cache
rules.why_safe: Downloaded pod sources. CocoaPods fetches them again on the next pod install.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.why_safe: Compiled Go packages. Go rebuilds them on the next build.

rules.title: Cargo registry downloads
rules.why_safe: Downloaded crate archives. Cargo downloads them again when a build needs them.

rules.title: Gradle caches
rules.why_safe: Downloaded dependencies and build caches. Gradle fetches them again, which can take a long time on big projects.
rules.rebuild_hint: Next Gradle build downloads dependencies again
